about: The estate's resource ledger: every place an agent can run, deliver or notify, by name and location only. A credential appears as the vault that holds it, never as a value, and the names of sensitive entries are not listed. Founder-only authority is deliberately absent: an agent never looks it up. status is what a probe or a dated measurement showed, never what a document declared. BUILT-UNPROBED means the thing exists as declared but no probe ran.
